newsitem.title: USA: National Patent raises stock-swap ratio.
newsitem.headline: National Patent raises stock-swap ratio.

text.p: National Patent Development Corp said Tuesday it had elected to exercise its option to increase the stock swap ratio in its planned takeover of General Physics Corp to 0.60 share of National Patent for each General Physics share.
National Patent said General Physics stockholders would receive $5 worth of National Patent stock for each General Physics share.
National Patent already owns 52 percent of General Physics. It is raising its ownship to 100 percent.
National Patent said it would issue 3,028,574 shares in the takeover.
A joint meeting of National Patent and General Physics shareholders is set for January 23 to consider the proposed merger.
In the event that both companies approve the merger, the closing is expected January 24.
General Physics provides engineering, environmental, training, analytical and technical support services to commercial nuclear and fossil power utilities.
